articles.title: Scientists Say: Theropod
articles.snippet: This group of dinosaurs once included Tyrannosaurus rex . Today, they include birds.
articles.summary: Scientists say that the group of dinosaurs called theropods once included the Tyrannosaurus rex. Today, this same group includes birds.
